data.title: 胡桃 · 无妄坡幽火幻舞
data.description: 【胡桃 · 无妄坡幽火幻舞】夜幕笼罩下的无妄坡古树林间，幽蓝色的磷火在空中静静漂浮。胡桃身姿轻盈地侧立在盘虬卧龙的古木枝头，单手掐诀操控着身边可爱的火灵小幽灵（Boo Tao），嘴角挂着神秘莫测又调皮可爱的狡黠微笑——「阴阳有序，命运无常！往生堂第七十七代堂主胡桃，奉陪到底哦～」
data.action: 侧身轻点枝头，单手结印操控悬浮火灵小幽灵（Boo Tao），嘴角带着狡黠神秘微笑
data.lighting: 幽蓝鬼火冷光与赤红火灵暖光双色交织
data.camera: full-body shot, side view, branch and spirit in frame
data.promptProse: Hu Tao balances sideways on a broad Wuwang Hill branch, one hand forming a guiding sign toward Boo Tao and the other braced against the trunk. Her director coat, shorts and blossom-trimmed hat remain visible with both supported feet. Blue wisps recede between misty trunks below. The friendly spirit's red firelight warms her grin and sleeve, opposing the cool forest glow along the branch's far edge.
